quarterly_data.quarter: NiSource press release: NiSource announces long-term agreement with Microsoft (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NiSource announced a new long-term energy agreement with Microsoft for Microsoft's previously announced northwest Indiana campus, served through NiSource Generation Company LLC (GenCo) under a structure in which large-load customers fully fund the generation and infrastructure required to serve them. The agreement builds on the previously disclosed $1.4 billion expected customer savings over the life of data center customer contracts, increasing total expected NIPSCO electric customer savings to approximately $1.75 billion (as much as $140 per customer annually). In connection with the Microsoft agreement, GenCo has contracted 600 MW of battery storage under a long-term tolling agreement, to be developed and constructed by an affiliate of AGP Group and added to GenCo's pool resources designed to serve multiple large-load customers. Further operational and financial details are to be shared on the third quarter earnings call. CEO Lloyd Yates: 'This agreement reflects the balanced approach we believe is needed for Indiana to attract significant investment and create long-term jobs.'
quarterly_data.figure: total expected customer savings approximately $1.75 billion (from $1.4 billion); 600 MW battery storage tolling agreement

contracts.source: NiSource press release: NiSource announces long-term agreement with Microsoft (10-16-2026)
contracts.signal: Under the new long-term energy agreement, Microsoft is expected to begin taking electric service under a 20-year term starting in 2028; the GenCo-owned pool portfolio will be increased by approximately 1,100 MW, with NIPSCO and GenCo providing transmission and generation infrastructure to serve Microsoft's data center and NIPSCO's customers. Microsoft fully funds all generation and transmission required to serve its load.
contracts.units: approximately 1,100 MW of new generation resources
